default/30425.htm.text: Neti: Why, greetings! I see you are a frequent traveler. Well, have you been here and there? Since I got married, I am at home all day long, so sometimes I feel stifled. These days, I recollect the old memories of when I roamed around the kingdom. There were many hardships, but I miss the days when…

default/30425-1.htm.text: Neti: I was also a famous Treasure Hunter when I was young... I was the one who retrieved the legendary Star Sapphire Crown from the Lost Harenak. In those days, they called me Aden's silver fox. You've never heard of that name? Sigh... Well, it was a very long time ago...

Q00171_ActsOfEvil/30425-01.html.text: Neti: I have a basic idea of your situation... Could I take a look at the Contract? This is the mark of the Silver Scale guild. Trader Rolento is the only Dwarf in this area who belongs to that guild... However, he would never supply weapons to the Ol Mahums... I'm sure there must have been a misun…

Q00171_ActsOfEvil/30425-02.html.text: Neti: Please do what you can to clear Trader Rolento's name as soon as possible. It is just appalling that a man of his character could have such scurrilous rumors circulated about him! He would never have supplied weapons to the Ol Mahums! Please, go to the south entrance of the Wasteland and meet…

Q00171_ActsOfEvil/30425-03.html.text: Neti: Well, I hear what you say, but I don't understand why Rolento would give weapons to the Ol Mahums... Surely he must have had some noble purpose? He must be aware of the seriousness of this offense... Let's hope for the best!

Q00403_PathOfTheRogue/30425-01.html.text: Neti: Oh blast it...! I suppose Bezique has already told you about my past? I can't refuse a request from Bezique. He saved me a long time ago when I was in a diffiult situation... But I really hate annoying jobs like this! Fine. If you really want to catch those thieves, you have to follow my word…

Q00403_PathOfTheRogue/30425-08.html.text: Neti: Now take the Horseshoe of Light that I have given you and go to Captain Bezique .

You must use The Bow and dagger that I gave you. If you bring back ten bone pieces as proof of your success, I will let you pass the test. If you don't know the way to…

Q00403_PathOfTheRogue/30425-07.html.text: Neti: Thank you. That is sufficient to catch the thieves. To prove your ability, I give you the Horseshoe of Light . Take this to Captain Bezique . And take care to catch the thieves with the weapons I have given you. I assure you they will come in handy in catching thieves.

Q00403_PathOfTheRogue/30425-02.html.text: Neti: Rumor has it that the thieves are very nimble. If you want to deal with them, you must increase your agility to their level. That is probably why Bezique said that he would acknowledge you as a Rogue if you catch those thieves. Great agility is the main talent you must have to be a Rogue. Bef…

Q00403_PathOfTheRogue/30425-03.html.text: Neti: Well then, have it your way! I only talked with you because Bezique asked me to help you, but since you don't want to, it's all the better. These tasks really annoy me, too!

Q00403_PathOfTheRogue/30425-04.html.text: Neti: All right. I accept your apology. But only this once. So listen carefully to my words. Rumor has it that the thieves are very nimble. If you want to deal with them, you must increase your agility to their level. That is probably why Bezique said that he would acknowledge you as a Rogue if you…

Q00403_PathOfTheRogue/30425-05.html.text: Neti: First, take this bow and dagger. To engage in combat that depends on agility, you must be able to use a bow and dagger skillfully, rather than a sword or axe.
